description: Read Google Voice through ordinary HTTP and recover evidence from a local message mirror.

novel_features.name: Compound message evidence
novel_features.description: Find messages using participant, dates, direction, literal text and attachment evidence together.

novel_features.name: Message-anchored context packet
novel_features.description: Retrieve neighboring messages around a known message, including collection boundaries.

novel_features.name: Question-scoped coverage evidence
novel_features.description: See freshness, unfinished pagination and collection failures before relying on a lookup.

novel_features.name: Observed conversation activity
novel_features.description: See observed inbound and outbound counts and latest message times per conversation.

novel_features.name: Newly mirrored records
novel_features.description: Inspect which records collection added, keeping old backfill distinct from recent communication.
